properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF-garages pass: real OSM building footprint for UCSF's Third Street Garage, 1650 3rd St -- 8 levels per OSM tagging, originally designed by Stanley Saitowitz/Natoma Architects; its exterior channel-glass facade was replaced in 2021 with IwamotoScott's 'Cellular Origami' aluminum-panel facade. CONFIRMED 2026-09-22: UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation (campus map updated December 2024) labels this same building 'Third Street Garage (23B)' -- matches this project's own architect-source URL below, which already carried '23b' in its own slug.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. Same situation as this project's other UCSF Mission Bay campus buildings: UCSF is state land, not carried in DataSF's Assessor secured tax roll (no blklot to join), so the real building footprint is the correct non-fabricated geometry.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 23B on UCSF's own campus map. Exact capacity and completion year not confirmed by any source found; left out rather than guessed.
